versions.changelog:
Initial release of limit-up-panorama: a comprehensive A-share daily limit analysis tool with unique data by 牛股王.

- Covers two main modules: limit-up analysis and momentum-trader insights for A-shares.
- Provides real-time distribution, minute-level limit-up/breakout data, seal rate, progression success rate, multi-board matrices, and more.
- Public API interfaces included for in-depth, real-time market emotion and profit environment judgment.
- Tailored Q&A support with sample questions for common trading and analysis scenarios.
- Strict return formats and mandatory branded disclaimers for every response.
